observations: Photo 0 shows a blue industrial gearbox with a shaft on the right and a flange/mounting face on the left.
A label/sticker is visible on the gearbox body, but the text is not clearly readable in this image.
No electric motor is visible in photo 0—only the gearbox.

claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor 20hp ratio 1:10
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a gearbox; the motor and the 20hp rating and 1:10 ratio are not readable/confirmed from the photo.

risks.risk: Motor not included or not the stated 20hp (photo shows only gearbox).
risks.proof: Send photo(s) of the electric motor nameplate (HP/kW, voltage, RPM) and the full set showing motor + gearbox connected (or separate with clear identification).
risks.if_unproven: Price as gearbox only, and treat motor as not included.

risks.risk: Gear ratio may not be 1:10 (ratio plate/label not readable).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate/ratio marking (or a clear shot of the label showing ratio).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown ratio gearbox (worst case vs stated ratio).

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown (no running test, no oil leak check).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox/motor running under load (or at least a no-load spin) plus photos of oil level/any leaks and the input/output shaft play.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case).

risks.risk: Compatibility issues (shaft size, mounting pattern, and coupling not confirmed).
risks.proof: Photos with measurements: input/output shaft diameter, keyway size, bolt pattern/flange dimensions, and coupling type; include a tape measure in-frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price with compatibility risk (worst case: may require parts/adapter).

proof_requests: Photo of the electric motor nameplate showing HP (or kW), voltage, frequency, and RPM.
Close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate showing ratio (1:10) and model/serial.
Video of the motor + gearbox running (even short) showing smooth operation and no abnormal noise.
Photos of gearbox oil level and any leaks; plus shaft play check (input/output).
Measurements of shaft diameters and flange/mounting bolt pattern (with tape measure).
response.reason: The photo only shows a gearbox and the key details needed to price correctly (motor presence/HP and the 1:10 ratio) are not verifiable from the image. Request the nameplates and a running proof before pricing.
